{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uRebarHook` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Rebar block)
{{% /callout %}}

Changes the hooks of rebar: the tail, the angle, a rotation of the hook plane, or the side of the hook. It is the hook half of what the findings of [uRebarInspector](../../model-plugins/urebarinspector/) point to; the shape half is [uRebarShape](../urebarshape/). It replaces the hook tab of uRebarInspector 26.1.18 and earlier, and uRebarHookTools.

**How to use:**

1.  Select the rebar in Tekla, or leave the selection empty. Choose the operation in the dialog and click **Apply**. The preselected rebar is used once; after that you pick rebar and finish each pick with a middle-click. <kbd>Esc</kbd> ends the command.
2.  Each round changes the picked rebar in one step, so one Undo takes it back, and the status line says how many objects were changed. Objects that were not changed are listed with the reason after the round.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Operation** | Set tail, Set angle, Rotate or Reverse hook. Only the options of the chosen operation are shown. |
| **Ends** | Both ends, Start or End (Set tail and Set angle). The start is the first point of the bar, the end the last. |
| **Set** | Set tail: *Tail x d* sets the straight part of the hook as a multiple of the nominal bar diameter (10 by default), *Tail mm* sets it in mm (160), *Leg mm* sets the dimensioned leg (L1 at the start, Ln at the end; 300). Each of the three keeps its own value. |
| **Angle** | Set angle: 90, 135 or 180 degrees. Each hook keeps its side, its straight tail and its bend radius and becomes a custom hook. Use [uRebarShape](../urebarshape/) › To catalog to bring the radius and tail of the new angle to the catalog. |
| **Axis, Nudge** | Rotate: adds a point in the middle of the bar and moves it by the nudge (1 mm by default, negative the other way), which makes Tekla turn the hook plane. *X*, *Y* and *Z* are the global axes, whatever work plane is current; *Pick points* takes the direction from two points you pick. Single bars and rebar groups only. |
| **Reverse hook** | Swaps the side of both hooks of every bar that has one: the angle is negated and the hook becomes a custom hook. |

Rebar sets and meshes have no hooks of their own to change and are listed as skipped. So is a bar with no hook (or no measurable leg) at the chosen end, a hook whose tail or bend radius reads 0 (Set angle), and a hook that already has the angle.

<blockquote class="page-note">Which way the hook turns for each axis is decided by Tekla: try Rotate on one bar first.</blockquote>

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After a native failure partial changes can remain: inspect the reported object and use Undo.
{{% /callout %}}
